7582.d: Daemonheim (IPAc-en | d | iː | m | ə | n | h | aɪ | m Respell-en | DEE-mən-hyme ) is a huge dungeon complex beneath an ancient castle located on an icy peninsula in the eastern part of the Wilderness.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• Teleporting there by using the ring of kinship, which is received from the Dungeoneering tutor.
• Teleporting to Daemonheim Dig Site by using the dig sites map located in the Archaeology Guild (with level 73 Archaeology after rescuing Skaldrun).
• Dungeoneering portal in the Tower of Voices in Prifddinas.
• Taking the Fremennik ship from south-western Taverley by talking to Bryll Thoksdottir at the docks. While the Fremennik shipmaster at Daemonheim can take players back to Taverley, be careful not to click the third option or on the Fremennik ship behind him, as they will take players to the Shadow Reef, a high-level combat zone without any warning about its dangers.
• Walking through the Wilderness to the east.
• War's Retreat Teleport then enter the Shadow Reef boss portal.

7587.d: The Daemonheim Dig Site is an Archaeology mini-dig site located on the Daemonheim peninsula.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• Archaeology teleport, purchased for 250 chronotes from Ezreal at the Archaeology Guild Shop.
• Archaeology journal, teleport to the Archaeology Campus then running west, inside the main building, and use the dig sites map table inside to teleport to it directly
• Master archaeologist's outfit teleport function.
• Teleporting there by using the ring of kinship, which is received from the Dungeoneering tutor
• Prifddinas portal in the Tower of Voices
• Taking the ferry from Al Kharid or Lumbridge Swamp
• Taking the ferry from south-western Taverley by talking to Bryll Thoksdottir at the docks. While the Fremennik shipmaster at Daemonheim can take players back to either Al Kharid or Taverley, be careful not to click the third option or on the Fremennik ship behind him, as they will take players to The Shadow Reef, a high-level combat zone without any warning about its dangers
• Walking through the Wilderness
• War's Retreat Teleport then take The Shadow Reef portal

7627.d: The Dagannoth Kings are a group of three dagannoths living deep in the cave on Waterbirth Island.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
The Kings reside in the sixth level of the Waterbirth Island Dungeon.

The simplest way to reach them is by using a Dagannoth Kings teleport into the Waterbirth dungeon. You will appear in a cave near the entrance to the arena. Players with access to the Max Guild can retune the boss portal. Alternatively one of the War's retreats portals (PvM Hub) can be used if the player has killed at least one of the Kings. Both boss portals will teleport the player directly in front of the entrance, making them the closest teleport option.

If not using one of the above methods to get directly to the lair, it will be necessary to travel to Waterbirth Island using one of the methods below and then navigate through the dungeon to reach the lair.
• Teleport to Rellekka (using the Fremennik Province lodestone, enchanted lyre or house teleport) and then take the boat to Waterbirth Island by speaking to Jarvald on the westernmost pier. You will appear at the southwestern corner of the island and need to run counter-clockwise around the perimeter of the island until you reach a dungeon entrance.
• After completion of the hard Fremennik achievements, the enchanted lyre can be set to teleport to Waterbirth Island.
• The Mask of the Dagannoth or Helm of the Dagannoth can teleport you directly to the entrance of the dungeon on Waterbirth Island.
• Waterbirth Teleport in the Lunar spells can take a player directly to the island. 

Once inside the dungeon, go through the doors at the far end and follow the path marked on the map.
